implementation: Pitney Bowes iButton Postal Security Device (PSD)
description: The Pitney Bowes iButton Postal Security Device (PSD) complies with FIPS 140-2 standards to support the USPS IBIP and international digital indicia standards globally. The PSD employs strong cryptographic and physical security techniques for the protection of customer funds in Pitney Bowes Postage Metering products.
